points.description: Identifies the stimulus for Sam as the mosquito landing on / being on his arm (feeling or seeing it). Equivalent wording such as 'the mosquito on his arm' or 'the sensation of the mosquito biting/landing' is accepted. Do not accept the response (slapping at it), or Jasmine's soda spill/jumping up, as the stimulus.

rubric.notes: Full mark for naming the mosquito on Sam's arm (felt or seen) as the stimulus. No marks for naming Sam's slapping (the response) or the soda/Jasmine's jump, which is the stimulus for Jasmine.
